verdict.rationale: Docs confirm signed-ish delivery semantics via stable event IDs for dedup, required 200-response acknowledgment for retry logic, and a web-app UI to inspect delivery status and re-deliver (replay) events after downtime. However, evidence never explicitly documents payload signature verification (HMAC/signing secret) or details of the automatic retry schedule/backoff, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability at scale. Missing for 10: explicit signature-verification documentation, retry policy/backoff details, and third-party confirmation of webhook reliability in production.
